document.abstract: Integration for Education explores the progression made by the Curtin Business Schools Media Producer Clive Jones, in bringing to fruition the integration of the world of the PC to that of video, and how the different mediums can be integrated. The end result raises the challenge of putting 25-minute videos onto the Internet for live streaming, and shows how an integrated Web page is used for teaching a Masters degree course.

authors.bio: Clive Jones was born and raised in England. After leaving school he joined Top Rank and shortly after Rediffusion Ltd were he worked in both studio complexes. After a brief secondment to the BBC as film editor, Clive left the UK to seek his fortune under the sun arriving almost a year latter in Perth Western Australia having got there via the overland route through Asia, India and Singapore. For the next ten years Clive worked in SE Asia operating electronic surveying equipment in such diverse places as dessert islands and the jungles of Borneo. In 1981 Clive returned to Perth permanently and finally found, with the Curtin Business School, a vocation. Clive is married and has two young daughters.
